headline_marked: Rabindranath Tagore mural [[defaced with black ink]] at Khulna Railway Station
headline: Rabindranath Tagore mural defaced with black ink at Khulna Railway Station
summary: Only the portrait of the Nobel laureate was targeted among several eminent figures painted on the station's boundary wall.
details: Miscreants have defaced a mural of Nobel laureate Rabindranath Tagore on the boundary wall of Khulna Railway Station with black ink, sparking condemnation from local residents.

The artwork was commissioned by the Khulna City Corporation (KCC) and features portraits of eminent figures including Kazi Nazrul Islam, SM Sultan, and Fakir Lalon Shah, as well as the July Uprising and the Sundarbans.
A local shop employee noticed the defacement on Friday morning, suspecting the act was carried out under the cover of darkness on Thursday night.
Of all the portraits on the wall, only Tagore's portrait was specifically targeted and defaced with black ink.
Cultural activist Shariful Islam Salim described the incident as the work of an organized group, noting that similar acts have occurred in Dhaka.
Salim emphasized that Tagore's philosophy of free thought and secularism continues to inspire generations and called for those responsible to be brought to justice.
The officer-in-charge of Khulna Sadar Police Station, Lokman Hossain, stated that police have visited the scene and are currently investigating the matter.

headline_marked: 234 caps, 146 goals: [[Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football]]
headline: 234 caps, 146 goals: Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football
summary: The 41-year-old legend ends a record-breaking career with Portugal following a public rift with coach Jorge Jesus.
details: Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his retirement from international football, ending a historic career with Portugal. The 41-year-old forward holds the world record for the most international appearances with 234 caps and 146 goals.

The decision follows a public fallout with Portugal coach Jorge Jesus. Ronaldo had previously accused the coach of broken promises after being asked to warm up during a match against Norway but not being brought onto the field.

This dispute led to Ronaldo leaving the team camp and receiving a 30-day suspension and a fine. While there were rumors of a potential return, Ronaldo ultimately decided that it was the right moment to leave the national team.

Coach Jorge Jesus admitted he had expected Ronaldo to return but stated he respects the veteran's decision. He emphasized that his decisions were always made with the interests of the national team as the top priority.

Portugal is now preparing for Nations League matches against Denmark and Wales. Jesus has named a squad featuring new call-ups Gustavo Varela and Alberto Costa, alongside returning youngsters Rodrigo Mora and Geovany Quenda.
